title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, optimize cache parallelism, and bump actions
author: Morgan Li
description: Motivation: our monolithic CI workflow has become slow and brittle as we add more checks (lint, unit, e2e, release automation). This PR splits responsibilities into dedicated workflows to reduce wasted parallelism, improve cache hit rates, and make CI failures easier to triage. It also contains targeted cache/key improvements to reduce redundant downloads during matrix runs and bumps several GitHub Actions to their latest stable minor versions.
